aiVerification.summary: Valid diagnostic machine comparison exists, but the draft misframes the changed factor and includes a spurious measurement outcome.
issues: Changed factor should be AWF machine number comparison
Measurement outcome appears header-derived and invalid
Test!14 is cited but not shown in supplied context
Conclusion row says all machines remain high, not improvement
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Machine AWF #1 vs #2 vs #3
Remove baseline/changed-condition wording unless a baseline row is found
Keep one function-defect outcome with Input, OK, NG BAKO, Total NG, NG rate
Use visible purpose, content, header, data, and conclusion rows as evidence
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are sufficient for the function comparison, but not for the derived measurement stats.
